scope: Use a compact readable hierarchy for agent replies
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

conversation--reply-end-compact-dark.png.task: Scan headings, paragraphs and lists without oversized document typography.
conversation--reply-end-compact-dark.png.observations: The compact end position shows the concluding paragraph, Next step subheading and recommendation above the composer. Paragraph and list spacing is tighter without crowding. Dark appearance remains readable. Composer and navigation retain their placement.
